run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier-1 government portals queried for all jurisdictions. Fresh, current (Nov 2026) opportunities were recoverable for NSW (buy.nsw), VIC (Buying for Victoria), NT (QTOL) and ACT (Tenders ACT); the search index returned only stale/cached pages for AusTender (Cth), QLD (QTenders/supply.qld), WA, SA and TAS, so no current opportunities could be confirmed there this run. Tier-2 (water GBEs, universities, health/LHDs) and Tier-3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, mining, retail, construction/E1, charities) were scanned: these are predominantly registration- or login-gated, so portals were recorded in discovered_sources but no gated opportunities were invented. IMPORTANT: this session's network policy blocks direct access to every tender domain, so ALL captured opportunities are headline-level from WebSearch summaries and were NOT verified against live detail pages or documents.
gaps: CRITICAL - NETWORK: This session's network policy blocks outbound DNS to all tender domains (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au/buy.nsw, tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders/supply.qld.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au, tenders.sa.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, tenders.act.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au, data.gov.au, service.ariba.com, estimateone.com and corporate supplier portals). Every WebFetch returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND'. Consequently NO opportunity could be opened or verified: all entries were captured from WebSearch result summaries only, all are headline-level, and deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, exact values and contacts could not be obtained. These domains must be allow-listed in the session's network settings for a verified run.

AusTender (Commonwealth), QTenders/supply.qld (QLD), Tenders WA, Tenders SA and Tenders Tasmania: WebSearch returned only stale/cached pages (2020-2022 or mid-2026) - no current (Nov 2026) opportunities could be confirmed; deferred to a future run or an authenticated/allow-listed session.

Tier-3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery; Woolworths/Coles; BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside/Santos; CBA/Westpac/NAB/ANZ; Telstra/Optus/TPG; AGL/Origin/EnergyAustralia; Qantas): no publicly-visible open RFx found via WebSearch. Posting boards are registration-gated and buyer events are often invitation-only (out of scope). Portals recorded in discovered_sources; no corporate tenders fabricated.

Construction head-contractor -> subcontractor packages (EstimateOne/E1, iTWOcx, BidContender): platform requires a free login; trade-package invitations are not publicly verifiable and were not captured this run.
Universities: UTS (TenderLink) and University of Adelaide show open items but no closing dates were visible and pages were unreachable for verification; deferred.

A fresh NSW item - 'Milton Ulladulla Hospital Emergency Department overnight medical workforce' (Illawarra Shoalhaven LHD, listed ~2 Nov 2026) - was seen only via a third-party aggregator with no verifiable closing date; per the buyer-originated rule it was NOT recorded as a confirmed tender.

Sydney Water abrasive blasting & coating EOI (SWC-WS4645974632) and a bulk chemicals sourcing activity (WS5456313187) were surfaced but only via aggregators/old cache with no verifiable closing date; not recorded as confirmed tenders. Sydney Water sources (SAP Ariba) already in the known set.
